title: Think Parallax: Solving Multi-Hop Problems via Multi-View Knowledge-Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Jinliang Liu; Jiale Bai; Shaoning Zeng
why_relevant: Proposes a multi-view KG-RAG method for multi-hop QA, touching on noisy path exploration but focused on retrieval architecture rather than robustness under unreliable evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Does not study noise robustness, conflict, adversarial attacks, calibration, or uncertainty in a principled way.
